products.name: Frass Gold Organic Fertiliser
products.desc: Sieved, heat-treated BSF frass from hawker food waste. Slow-release nitrogen with chitin that helps roots resist pests.

products.name: Larvae Protein Meal
products.desc: Defatted BSF larvae meal. A drop-in replacement for part of the fishmeal in aquafeed formulations.

products.name: Dried BSF Larvae
products.desc: Whole sun-and-oven dried larvae. Treats for poultry, koi and arowana.

products.name: Kranji Frass Compost Blend
products.desc: Frass blended with composted leaf litter for raised beds and potting mixes.

products.name: Floating Fish Pellets (30% BSF)
products.desc: Extruded floating pellets for tilapia and barramundi grow-out. 30% of the protein comes from BSF meal.

products.name: Senoko High-K Frass
products.desc: Reformulated after buyer soil tests showed potassium gaps: larvae are fed a higher share of fruit peels, and the frass is blended with banana-stem ash.

products.name: BSF Chitin Flakes
products.desc: Chitin-rich flakes from shed larval skins and pupal cases. Mix into potting soil as a plant-health amendment.

products.name: Live Larvae for Poultry
products.desc: Fresh 5th-instar larvae, delivered within 24 hours. Chickens love them.

products.name: Coastal Frass Pellets
products.desc: Pelletised frass that spreads evenly with a hand spreader. Low dust.

products.name: Shrimp Starter Crumble
products.desc: Fine crumble for post-larval shrimp and fry nurseries.

products.name: Campus Grow Kit
products.desc: 2 kg of frass, a seed pack (kangkong, bayam, chilli) and a planting guide. Made by the NTU pilot.

products.name: Student Starter Frass
products.desc: Small pouch for balcony and hall-room planters.

products.name: Gangseo Frass Compost
products.desc: Heat-treated frass from Seoul market waste. For greenhouse lettuce and perilla.

products.name: Larvae Protein Meal
products.desc: Defatted BSF meal for eel and catfish feed mills.

products.name: Nowon High-K Frass
products.desc: Potassium-boosted batch made after buyer soil tests showed K gaps in cabbage fields.

products.name: Dried BSF Larvae
products.desc: Whole dried larvae for backyard poultry and pond fish.

products.name: Eel & Catfish Pellets (30% BSF)
products.desc: Sinking pellets for freshwater eel and catfish farms.

products.name: Rooftop Garden Kit
products.desc: Frass, perilla and lettuce seeds, and a planting card for apartment balconies.

products.name: BSF Chitin Flakes
products.desc: Chitin-rich flakes from shed larval skins. A soil-health amendment.
